declarations.description:
Marks one stop on a flight as a layover or a stopover.

**Key capabilities**
- **Layover**: A stop with a duration, shown as a filled marker. Set `duration` to show how long it lasts.
- **Stopover**: A stop with no duration, shown as an outlined marker. Set `stopover` to turn it on.
- **Cancellation**: `canceled` and `destinationCanceled` show the lines around the segment as canceled.

**Example**
```html
<auro-flight-segment iata="ORD" duration="3h 40m"></auro-flight-segment>
```
Read about [the difference between a layover and a stopover](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-int/any-questions/what-is-the-difference-between-a-layover-and-a-stopover/).
declarations.name: AuroFlightSegment

members.name: canceled
members.description: Marks the segment as canceled. The line leading to the segment is red and dashed, and the segment's marker is red.

members.name: destinationCanceled
members.description: Marks the final leg after the last segment as canceled. Use it on the last segment in a flightline, where it turns the line after the segment red and dashed and the duration text red.

members.name: duration
members.description: Sets the layover length shown under the station code, such as `3h 40m`. Don't set it on a stopover, because stopover durations can't be predicted.

members.name: iata
members.description: Sets the text shown under the segment's marker, typically a station code such as `SEA`.

members.name: nextDay
members.description: Marks a layover that extends into the next calendar day by showing its duration in red.

members.name: register

parameters.description: The tag name to register the element under.

members.description: Registers the element with the browser under a tag name.

declarations.description:
Shows a flight's layovers and stopovers as dots on a timeline that adapts to its width.

**Key capabilities**
- **Shows each stop**: Each `<auro-flight-segment>` in the default slot adds a dot to the timeline.
- **Adapts to narrow spaces**: When it has two or more segments and is `320px` wide or narrower, it shows the number of stops instead of the dots.
- **Shows cancellations**: `canceled` shows the whole flight as canceled.

**Example**
```html
<auro-flightline>
  <auro-flight-segment iata="SEA" duration="1h 40m"></auro-flight-segment>
</auro-flightline>
```
